notes: This contract records the provider- and FOM-independent C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 HLAauthorizerFactoryFactory surface. It verifies standard-authorizer selection, factory and authorizer naming, authorizer creation, and rejection of an unsupported implementation name. It is an API contract check only and does not claim provider-specific authorization policy.

api_surfaces.signature: HLAauthorizerFactoryFactory selection and standard AuthorizerFactory/Authorizer creation
